documents.review_rationale: The observed current artifact is a public policy wording served from Bajaj General's official download domain and matches the reviewed My Health Care Plan product identity. The artifact is registered as a separate immutable document version because semantic comparison against the historical artifact found material operative changes. This classification does not itself promote the document to current publication status.

guardrails: Document classification is a reviewable policy decision and is hash-bound to the registered document version.
Restricted policy-, group-, and member-specific documents are never reusable generic evidence.
Discovery-only documents cannot establish a legal entitlement or reusable legal assertion on their own.
Unknown documents remain blocked pending review.
This manifest does not alter raw documents, extraction artifacts, rules, evidence bindings, or authority state.
